title: Chat card (cards/<name>.json)

title.title: Text
title.description: A lang key or literal text.

label.title: Text
label.description: A lang key or literal text.

value.title: Formula
value.description: Reads `@total`, `@roll` (`expression`, `resolved`, `total`, `natural`, `dice`), the recipe's `@rolls` and `@let`, and the entity's data. It cannot roll dice.

apply.description: Buttons the card shows by each target of the roll, for those who may edit it; each steps a counter of the target once. Only for recipes with `target`.

label.title: Text
label.description: The button, such as "Apply damage"; a lang key or literal text.

field.description: The path of a counter (`x-counter`) of each type the recipe targets, such as `hp.value`.

amount.title: Formula
amount.description: How much to step the counter by, worked out when the roll is made: negative lowers it, such as `-@rolls.damage.total`. It reads what rows read.

description: How a recipe roll shows in chat.
